capabilities: add transactions through a form saved as markdown files
validate double-entry transactions with zero-sum enforcement
show balances and income & expenses views
filter transactions by date range, text, and hashtags
extras: The README ends with an empty 'Screenshots' section; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The README lists 'No new apps to install or maintain. Lives inside Obsidian.' as a selling point, implying the author wanted accounting inside the vault without extra software.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record and review personal finances, and plain-text accounting normally requires installing and maintaining a separate app.
summary: Plain-text money tracker that stores transactions as markdown files with double-entry validation, multi-currency support, and balance views.
